applicability_rationale: No Bombus species is native to sub-Saharan Africa; the Bombus channel is structurally inapplicable to islands sourced from the SW Cape mainland.
No Bombus species is native to lowland West/Central Africa or the Gulf of Guinea; the Bombus channel is structurally inapplicable.
Temperate Japan has a rich native Bombus fauna (e.g. Bombus ardens, B. diversus, B. hypocrita); the Bombus channel is ecologically applicable to islands sourced from this region.
